Ana: Heads up team 1: Launch week for the benchmark + webinar. Need X thread, LinkedIn carousel, two asset cards, and inbound routing to SDR queue. Whos in? :rocket:
Ravi: Ill draft the X thread + 3 micro-posts. Need benchmark PNGs and one pull-quote. ETA Mon EOD.
Bea: Ill design 3 LinkedIn carousel variants (exec/tech/product). Will A/B CTAs (download vs book demo).
Jon: Routing: set webinar form -> Zapier -> Salesforce lead queue "SDR-Marketing" with tag "benchmark-2026". Also add form field product_interest. @Ana can you give form edit access?
Ana: Yep Ill own the form. Marcom-bot drop link please.
Marcom-bot: Form: https://airtable.com/shrLMN456 (permissions: marketing-edit).
Ravi: Messaging draft: "New benchmark: 2x faster inference and ~60% lower per-token cost at the 95th pctile." Legal needs methodology link and test notes for any numeric claims.
Jon: Legal ok if we include methodology sentence and a link to the report. Also please avoid absolutes.
Bea: Scheduling suggestion: X at 10:00 PT, LinkedIn at 11:00 PT, boost at 12:30 PT. Staggered schedule seems best.
Ana: Can someone monitor DMs/comments first 4 hours? Ravi volunteer?
Ravi: I can take first 3 hours, then hand to Jon. Ill post an engagement tracker in #launch-live when we go.
Ana: Checklist: assets in /marketing/benchmarks/assets by Mon noon, landing page UTMs set, form field added, legal blurb included. Ping here for blockers.
Marcom-bot: Reminder scheduled: post X at 1973003600, LinkedIn at 1973007200.
